tagline: Delivering regulated electric and natural gas service to Midwest customers
hero_kpi_rationale: Stable electric customer base of 1.01 million in the Midwest, reflecting Alliant Energy's established position as a regulated electric utility provider

kpis.name: Electric Customers
kpis.description: Alliant Energy serves approximately 1,010,000 electric customers in the Midwest (505,000 via IPL in Iowa and 505,000 via WPL in Wisconsin)

kpis.name: Natural Gas Customers
kpis.explanation: Number of natural gas customers served
kpis.description: Alliant Energy serves approximately 435,000 natural gas customers in the Midwest (230,000 via IPL in Iowa and 205,000 via WPL in Wisconsin)

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Alliant Energy has implemented a comprehensive cybersecurity program including a dedicated team, security operations center, and NERC standards compliance, but measures may be insufficient to prevent all incidents. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company must comply with NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection standards and Department of Homeland Security Transportation Security Administration regulations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Third-Party Dependencies
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on third parties for certain critical services and regularly collaborates with federal authorities and external consultants. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Demand Realization Risk
risks.score_rationale: Alliant Energy has electric service agreements with data center customers for approximately 3 GW of peak demand, but actual timing and amounts depend on interconnection factors and variable demand. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Alliant Energy has no significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar AI technologies in the 10-K. The company focuses on investments in renewable energy, energy storage, and distribution infrastructure modernization.
